nodes.title: Personalised Dachshund 1 Word Art Poster Print
nodes.descriptionHtml:
A High Quality framed or un-framed Personalised Print. They are High-Quality Prints in Full Colour and framed in Black, Silver, White or Gold Frames. You can even choose if you want your print in A3, A4 or as a card.

The A3 frames have a clip on the back to be hung on a wall to show-off to your friends and family and A4 frames have a stand to easily display on any surface. The perfect Birthday or Christmas present for anyone

This is a perfect gift for any new born baby. Perfect for birthdays, 16th birthday, 18th birthday, 25th birthday, christmas gifts, new borns, gifts, new baby wall art, new home wall art and christenings. We offer word art prints for him and her, pets, children and family so please check our other products for these. 

All our Prints are printed on: 

A4 - 350gsm Card

A3 - 170gsm Gloss

A2 - 210gsm Gloss

A1 - 210 gsm Gloss


Posted Next working day (or same day if ordered before 12pm)

All our Prints are Shipped by Royal Mail

what words should I send?

Starting with the birthday person's first name, send a simple list of around 20-30 separate words. It should mainly be single separate words but certainly NO PHRASES over 3 words long. Words such as hobbies, likes and habits can be included that may describe the person the gift is for.

Only the words you send in will be included on the design. PLEASE double check your spelling and PLEASE use commas. Do not include any shapes, icons or foreign worl letter accents.

How is it made?

We copy and paste your words from your message. Please bear in mind the first word on your list is displayed once prominently.

Other words that are included will be repeated randomly and displayed in different sizes, fonts and shades.

We print exactly what you enter, so please check names and spelling carefully before you order.

A High Quality framed or un-framed Personalised Print. They are High-Quality Prints in Full Colour and framed in Black, Silver, White or Gold Frames. You can even choose if you want your print in A3, A4 or as a card.

The A3 frames have a clip on the back to be hung on a wall to show-off to your friends and family and A4 frames have a stand to easily display on any surface. The perfect Birthday or Christmas present for anyone

This is a perfect gift for any new born baby. Perfect for birthdays, 16th birthday, 18th birthday, 25th birthday, christmas gifts, new borns, gifts, new baby wall art, new home wall art and christenings. We offer word art prints for him and her, please check our other products for these. 

All our Prints are printed on: 

A4 - 350gsm Card

A3 - 170gsm Gloss

A2 - 210gsm Gloss

A1 - 210 gsm Gloss


Posted Next working day (or same day if ordered before 12pm)

All our Prints are Shipped by Royal Mail

what words should I send?

Starting with the birthday person's first name, send a simple list of around 20-30 separate words. It should mainly be single separate words but certainly NO PHRASES over 3 words long. Words such as hobbies, likes and habits can be included that may describe the person the gift is for.

Only the words you send in will be included on the design. PLEASE double check your spelling and PLEASE use commas. Do not include any shapes, icons or foreign worl letter accents.

How is it made?

We copy and paste your words from your message. Please bear in mind the first word on your list is displayed once prominently.

Other words that are included will be repeated randomly and displayed in different sizes, fonts and shades.

We print exactly what you enter, so please check names and spelling carefully before you order.

A High Quality framed or un-framed Personalised Print. They are High-Quality Prints in Full Colour and framed in Black, Silver, White or Gold Frames. You can even choose if you want your print in A3, A4 or as a card.

The A3 frames have a clip on the back to be hung on a wall to show-off to your friends and family and A4 frames have a stand to easily display on any surface. The perfect Birthday or Christmas present for anyone

This is a perfect gift for any new born baby. Perfect for birthdays, 16th birthday, 18th birthday, 25th birthday, christmas gifts, new borns, gifts, new baby wall art, new home wall art and christenings. We offer word art prints for him and her, pets, children and family so please check our other products for these. 

All our Prints are printed on: 

A4 - 350gsm Card

A3 - 170gsm Gloss

A2 - 210gsm Gloss

A1 - 210 gsm Gloss


Posted Next working day (or same day if ordered before 12pm)

All our Prints are Shipped by Royal Mail

what words should I send?

Starting with the birthday person's first name, send a simple list of around 20-30 separate words. It should mainly be single separate words but certainly NO PHRASES over 3 words long. Words such as hobbies, likes and habits can be included that may describe the person the gift is for.

Only the words you send in will be included on the design. PLEASE double check your spelling and PLEASE use commas. Do not include any shapes, icons or foreign worl letter accents.

How is it made?

We copy and paste your words from your message. Please bear in mind the first word on your list is displayed once prominently.

Other words that are included will be repeated randomly and displayed in different sizes, fonts and shades.

We print exactly what you enter, so please check names and spelling carefully before you order.

A High Quality framed or un-framed Personalised Print. They are High-Quality Prints in Full Colour and framed in Black, Silver, White or Gold Frames. You can even choose if you want your print in A3, A4 or as a card.

The A3 frames have a clip on the back to be hung on a wall to show-off to your friends and family and A4 frames have a stand to easily display on any surface. The perfect Birthday or Christmas present for anyone

This is a perfect gift for any new born baby. Perfect for birthdays, 16th birthday, 18th birthday, 25th birthday, christmas gifts, new borns, gifts, new baby wall art, new home wall art and christenings. We offer word art prints for him and her, pets, children and family so please check our other products for these. 

All our Prints are printed on: 

A4 - 350gsm Card

A3 - 170gsm Gloss

A2 - 210gsm Gloss

A1 - 210 gsm Gloss


Posted Next working day (or same day if ordered before 12pm)

All our Prints are Shipped by Royal Mail

what words should I send?

Starting with the birthday person's first name, send a simple list of around 20-30 separate words. It should mainly be single separate words but certainly NO PHRASES over 3 words long. Words such as hobbies, likes and habits can be included that may describe the person the gift is for.

Only the words you send in will be included on the design. PLEASE double check your spelling and PLEASE use commas. Do not include any shapes, icons or foreign worl letter accents.

How is it made?

We copy and paste your words from your message. Please bear in mind the first word on your list is displayed once prominently.

Other words that are included will be repeated randomly and displayed in different sizes, fonts and shades.

We print exactly what you enter, so please check names and spelling carefully before you order.

A High Quality framed or un-framed Personalised Print. They are High-Quality Prints in Full Colour and framed in Black, Silver, White or Gold Frames. You can even choose if you want your print in A3, A4 or as a card.

The A3 frames have a clip on the back to be hung on a wall to show-off to your friends and family and A4 frames have a stand to easily display on any surface. The perfect Birthday or Christmas present for anyone

This is a perfect gift for any new born baby. Perfect for birthdays, 16th birthday, 18th birthday, 25th birthday, christmas gifts, new borns, gifts, new baby wall art, new home wall art and christenings. We offer word art prints for him and her, pets, children and family so please check our other products for these. 

All our Prints are printed on: 

A4 - 350gsm Card

A3 - 170gsm Gloss

A2 - 210gsm Gloss

A1 - 210 gsm Gloss


Posted Next working day (or same day if ordered before 12pm)

All our Prints are Shipped by Royal Mail

what words should I send?

Starting with the birthday person's first name, send a simple list of around 20-30 separate words. It should mainly be single separate words but certainly NO PHRASES over 3 words long. Words such as hobbies, likes and habits can be included that may describe the person the gift is for.

Only the words you send in will be included on the design. PLEASE double check your spelling and PLEASE use commas. Do not include any shapes, icons or foreign worl letter accents.

How is it made?

We copy and paste your words from your message. Please bear in mind the first word on your list is displayed once prominently.

Other words that are included will be repeated randomly and displayed in different sizes, fonts and shades.

We print exactly what you enter, so please check names and spelling carefully before you order.

nodes.descriptionHtml:
A High Quality framed or un-framed Personalised Print. They are High-Quality Prints in Full Colour and framed in Black, Silver, White or Gold Frames. You can even choose if you want your print in A3, A4 or as a card.

The A3 frames have a clip on the back to be hung on a wall to show-off to your friends and family and A4 frames have a stand to easily display on any surface. The perfect Birthday or Christmas present for anyone

This is a perfect gift for any new born baby. Perfect for birthdays, 16th birthday, 18th birthday, 25th birthday, christmas gifts, new borns, gifts, new baby wall art, new home wall art and christenings. We offer word art prints for him and her, please check our other products for these. 

All our Prints are printed on: 

A4 - 350gsm Card

A3 - 170gsm Gloss

A2 - 210gsm Gloss

A1 - 210 gsm Gloss


Posted Next working day (or same day if ordered before 12pm)

All our Prints are Shipped by Royal Mail

what words should I send?

Starting with the birthday person's first name, send a simple list of around 20-30 separate words. It should mainly be single separate words but certainly NO PHRASES over 3 words long. Words such as hobbies, likes and habits can be included that may describe the person the gift is for.

Only the words you send in will be included on the design. PLEASE double check your spelling and PLEASE use commas. Do not include any shapes, icons or foreign worl letter accents.

How is it made?

We copy and paste your words from your message. Please bear in mind the first word on your list is displayed once prominently.

Other words that are included will be repeated randomly and displayed in different sizes, fonts and shades.

We print exactly what you enter, so please check names and spelling carefully before you order.

nodes.title: Personalised Name Word Art Poster Print Pink Letter L
nodes.descriptionHtml:
This personalised name word art print is a lovely way to put a name on the wall. A big pink letter L is filled with their name and the little words that tell their story. It makes gorgeous new baby wall art for a nursery or bedroom.

Your personalised name word art print, made with your words

Type their name in the first box; it appears once, in pride of place. In the second box, type 20 to 30 words separated by commas: hobbies, nicknames, family names, favourite places. We repeat them in different sizes, fonts and shades to fill the letter L. The preview shows your details before you add it to your basket.

Single words work best, and no phrase should be longer than three words. Check the spelling carefully, as we print exactly what you enter. Icons, emoji and accents can't be included.

Why you'll love it

  • Premium Display frames in black or silver: thick, chunky and very professional, not cheap thin frames
  • High-quality full-colour print, made to order in our own workshop
  • Four print-only sizes, from a shelf-sized A4 to a statement A1
  • Ready to display: A3 frames have a clip on the back for hanging, and A4 frames have a stand

Size & details

  • Design: a big pink letter L filled with your name and 20–30 words
  • Print only: A4 (210 x 297 mm), A3 (297 x 420 mm), A2 (420 x 594 mm) or A1 (594 x 841 mm)
  • Paper: A4 on 350gsm card, A3 on 170gsm gloss, A2 and A1 on 210gsm gloss
  • Framed: A4 (with a stand) or A3 (with a hanging clip) in a black or silver Premium Display frame

Delivery

Your personalised name word art print is posted the next working day, or the same day if you order before 12pm, by Royal Mail.

Whether it's for a birthday, a christening, a new home or Christmas morning, this is a gift they'll keep.
